annotations.exact_quote: we propose SS-NMF: a semi-supervised non-negative matrix factorization framework for data clustering
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确提出SS-NMF，采用非负矩阵分解框架进行数据聚类，属于论文核心方法。

annotations.exact_quote: users are able to provide supervision for clustering in terms of pairwise constraints on a few data objects specifying whether they “must” or “cannot” be clustered together.
annotations.reason_zh: 利用少量数据对象上的must/cannot成对约束作为有限监督来指导聚类，符合半监督学习以有限成对约束指导全部样本的设定。
使用少量对象的成对关系作为不完整实例监督指导聚类，该有限监督条件是所提方法的核心设定。
annotations.exact_quote: In SS-NMF, users are able to provide supervision for clustering in terms of pairwise constraints on a few data objects specifying whether they “must” or “cannot” be clustered together.
